name: Faces In The Last Days
overview: Scripture reveals that the last days will be marked by unprecedented tribulation and significant spiritual activity, including visions, dreams, and prophecy as God pours out His Spirit on all people (Joel 2:28; Matthew 24:21). Daniel highlights a time of great trouble unlike any before, yet also assures deliverance for those written in God's book (Daniel 12:1). The increase of knowledge and movement described in Daniel 12:4 points to a unique era preceding the end, while Jesus foretells the visible return of the Son of Man, which will bring mourning to all tribes of the earth and signal the culmination of history (Matthew 24:3, 24:30).
